newsitem.title: CHINA: China to keep Agribusiness trust stock business.
newsitem.headline: China to keep Agribusiness trust stock business.

text.p: The China Construction Bank will maintain the normal operations of the securities business of the now-defunct China Agribusiness Development Trust and Investment Corp (CADTIC), the China Securities said on Wednesday.
In a brief front-page notice, the construction bank said it had taken over the securities business of the CADTIC and would maintain normal operations.

China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, announced on Tuesday the closure of CADTIC, one of China's largest investment trust houses, for irregularities and other serious problems, effective from January 4.
The Bank of China had been made responsible for CADTIC's overseas business operations, officials said.
